description.narrative: Based in Saint Lucia but also operating in St. Vincent and the Grenadines and St. Kitts and Nevis, Helen's Daughters works with women in rural areas using agriculture as an entry-point for overall development. They provide training, mentorship, micro-investment, access to high-value markets, and a structured care-system for rural women farmers, who have largely been unacknowledged and under-supported in the agricultural sector. They work at the intersection of gender and agriculture while incorporating aspects of climate resilience, community health, and social equity into their programs and initiatives. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, bank fees, auditing fees, and monitoring and evaluation fees.
